stories.title: Unos 2.000 inmigrantes vuelven a las playas tras la saturación en el campamento del puerto de Ceuta

en.title: Around 2,000 immigrants return to beaches after overcrowding at Ceuta port camp
en.summary: Approximately 2,000 immigrants have returned to beaches in Ceuta following overcrowding at a port facility camp. The camp has capacity for 1,700 people but around 5,000 individuals are seeking entry, creating tension during the transfer operation.

stories.title: Mbappé pone fin a su idilio con Nike y ficha con la marca suiza On

en.title: Mbappé ends Nike partnership and signs with Swiss brand On
en.summary: Kylian Mbappé, captain of the French national team and Real Madrid forward, has terminated his nearly 20-year commercial relationship with Nike to sign with Swiss sportswear company On. The partnership adds the football star to On's roster alongside athletes and celebrities like Thierry Henry and Zendaya.

stories.title: El Trompas confiesa el asesinato de Claudia Tacoronte en México

en.title: El Trompas confesses to the murder of Claudia Tacoronte in Mexico
en.summary: Francisco Javier M., alias El Trompas, detained in Mexico for the murder of Spanish university student Claudia Tacoronte, has allegedly confessed to the crime to Mexican authorities. Spain's Foreign Minister confirmed the confession following communication with his Mexican counterpart.

stories.title: El Trompas confiesa a las autoridades mexicanas que mató a la estudiante española Claudia Tacoronte

en.title: El Trompas confesses to Mexican authorities that he killed Spanish student Claudia Tacoronte
en.summary: A Spanish student was killed during a robbery attempt, according to Mexican authorities who have ruled out a sexual motive for the assault. The suspect El Trompas has confessed to the crime.

stories.title: Detenido ‘El Trompas’, presunto asesino de la estudiante española Claudia Tacoronte en México

en.title: 'El Trompas' arrested, suspected killer of Spanish student Claudia Tacoronte in Mexico
en.summary: Mexican authorities have reported to Spain's Foreign Minister that a suspect in the death of Spanish student Claudia Tacoronte has been detained and has allegedly confessed to the crime.

stories.title: Mbappé rompe con Nike y ficha por On, la marca de zapatillas participada por Federer

en.title: Mbappé breaks with Nike and signs with On, the shoe brand backed by Federer
en.summary: Kylian Mbappé has ended his partnership with Nike to become the global face of Swiss sportswear company On, which aims to expand into professional football and compete with Nike and Adidas.

stories.title: El presidente del puerto de Ceuta denuncia que «se ha enterado por la televisión» del traslado a los inmigrantes

en.title: President of Ceuta Port complains he learned about immigrant transfer through television
en.summary: The president of Ceuta Port stated that he was not officially notified in advance about the relocation of hundreds of immigrants to port facilities and learned about the operation through media coverage.

stories.title: Bombazo en la industria deportiva: Kylian Mbappé deja Nike y ficha por la suiza On

en.title: Major sports industry shake-up: Kylian Mbappé leaves Nike and signs with Swiss On
en.summary: Real Madrid forward Kylian Mbappé has become a global ambassador and shareholder of Swiss sportswear brand On, marking the company's entry into professional football with support from Thierry Henry.

stories.title: Jonathan Andic niega haberse interesado por terapias que incluyesen exponer a un familiar al borde un barranco

en.title: Jonathan Andic denies interest in therapies involving exposing a relative to the edge of a cliff
en.summary: A witness reported that Jonathan Andic's therapist recommended a nature hike involving an extreme situation at a cliff. Andic denies having shown interest in such therapeutic methods.

stories.title: La hora de Florentino en Ceuta entre el traslado de inmigrantes y la polémica de Mbappé y Vinicius: "No hemos preparado la visita por ninguna noticia"

en.title: Florentino's moment in Ceuta amid immigrant transfers and the Mbappé and Vinicius controversy: "We did not prepare the visit for any news"
en.summary: A Real Madrid delegation including Florentino Pérez visited Ceuta while thousands of migrants were being relocated. The visit's timing coincided with various controversies.

stories.title: Operación Puerto de Ceuta: el Gobierno habla de un 'efecto llamada' y se quedan más de 3.000 inmigrantes en la calle

en.title: Ceuta Port Operation: Government speaks of a 'pull factor' and over 3,000 immigrants remain on the street
en.summary: More than 3,000 migrants gathered at Ceuta beaches after descending from mountain locations, seeking placement in a new facility. The government attributed the increased arrivals to a pull factor effect.

stories.title: Detenido 'El Trompas', el sospechoso del asesinato de la española Claudia Tacoronte en México

en.title: El Trompas arrested as suspect in murder of Spanish woman Claudia Tacoronte in Mexico
en.summary: Authorities arrested a suspect in connection with the death of Claudia Tacoronte, a Spanish woman killed with a blade weapon on September 12 in Cuautla, Mexico.

stories.title: El golpe de On a Nike: ficha a Mbappé y prepara sus primeras botas de fútbol

en.title: On's blow to Nike: signs Mbappé and prepares its first football boots
en.summary: Swiss company On ended Mbappé's two-decade association with Nike by signing him as global ambassador and shareholder. On plans to launch football boots in 2027 with Thierry Henry as division director.

stories.title: El Ibex cae hasta los 19.500 puntos y pierde en la semana un 1,6%

en.title: The Ibex falls to 19,500 points and loses 1.6% for the week
en.summary: Spain's Ibex index declined to 19,500 points, posting a weekly loss of 1.6%. Futures expiration and oil price movements influenced trading, offsetting gains from recent central bank rate decisions.

stories.title: Irán activa las rutas terrestres para eludir el bloqueo estadounidense

en.title: Iran activates land routes to evade US blockade
en.summary: Iran is increasing reliance on land-based trade routes through neighboring countries like Turkey to circumvent American naval restrictions and sanctions.

stories.title: El CEO de Nvidia asegura que la IA hará que electricistas y albañiles sean algunos de los empleos mejor pagados

en.title: Nvidia CEO says AI will make electricians and construction workers among the best-paid jobs
en.summary: Nvidia's CEO contends that artificial intelligence's impact on employment may create opportunities in unexpected sectors, with skilled trades becoming highly compensated roles.

stories.title: La familia real de Liechtenstein amenaza con una demanda por las reformas dinásticas

en.title: Liechtenstein royal family threatens lawsuit over dynastic reforms
en.summary: Tension within Europe's wealthiest monarchy has intensified after Prince Alois expanded his control over family matters, prompting legal threats from other family members.
